name: Brazil
dossier:
The Brazil national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Seleção, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 5 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CONMEBOL to this expanded 48-team tournament.

The most successful nation in history, chasing a sixth star to end a 24-year wait.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Brazil will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group C and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group C. The connection between Vinícius Júnior and Rodrygo is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Vinícius Júnior - the clinical winger who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Brazil are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Brazil are the only nation to play in every World Cup ever held  -  and the only five-time champions.
Brazil boast 5 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Champions (x5).
